raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary (human-written)
<!-- Write this yourself, not with an AI tool. 2-5 sentences: the problem, why
     this approach, and what you checked yourself. -->

## Why
The Real PG integration suite (`8 GPU Integration (Real PG - full suite - features)`) and the ROCm integration suite have failed the `sft` loss check on main since #5757 (`899480301`; `a87db08ea` before it passed):

```
[sft] AssertionError: 7.889825820922852 != 7.887711524963379 : loss mismatch at step 1   # A10G
[sft] AssertionError: 7.890093803405762 != 7.887524604797363 : loss mismatch at step 1   # MI350X
```

#5757 renders `bos_token`/`eos_token` in Hugging Face chat templates, an intended change to the SFT token stream. It regenerated `tests/assets/losses/fake_pg/a10g/sft.txt` but not the real-PG A10G and MI350X goldens.

## What changed
- `tests/assets/losses/real_pg/a10g/sft.txt` and `tests/assets/losses/real_pg/mi350x/sft.txt`: steps 1-10 regenerated; headers unchanged.

## Numerics
The new values are the full-precision TensorBoard metrics of the failing main runs' baseline training (the same values `loss_compare.py --export-result` writes), read with `scripts/loss_compare.py`'s own extraction from the uploaded `integration-8gpu-features-outputs` artifacts:
- A10G: run 41746280593 (`e6ca6d861`). Step 1 matches the log's baseline (7.889825820922852, grad_norm 4.189799785614014).
- MI350X: the ROCm run on `73c4ebdac`. Step 1 matches the log's baseline (7.890093803405762, grad_norm 4.189815998077393).

The commits between #5757 and those runs (#5572, #5787, #5776, #5774, #5779, #5741, #5786) do not change SFT numerics.

## Testing
- CI: Real PG (`ciflow/real-pg`) and ROCm (`ciflow/rocm`) integration suites.
- A manual `export_results` run of the integration workflow for `sft` on main (run 41760303504) exported a real-PG A10G golden identical to this one.
- `Multi-GPU Unit Tests` fails here with the `_VisionEncoder ... named_preserve_dtype_params` error that is also on main; #5795 fixes it.

This PR was AI-assisted.

**Verdict: Approve -- please address the item below before merging.** This finishes the golden regeneration that #5757 left incomplete. The numbers are consistent with the logs the description cites.

**What this PR does.** #5757 started rendering `bos_token`/`eos_token` in HF chat templates, which is meant to change the SFT token stream. That PR updated only `fake_pg/a10g/sft.txt`. This PR updates the other two `sft` goldens that `features.py:1197` (`tests/assets/losses/{execution_mode}/{gpu_arch}/sft.txt`) resolves to: `real_pg/a10g` and `real_pg/mi350x`. After this, all three `sft.txt` files in the repo reflect the new token stream. No other suite or backend has an SFT golden. `sft_multiturn` has no golden file, so nothing else is left stale.

**Example.**
```
step 1 (A10G, FSDP=2)   loss                 grad_norm
before (golden)         7.887711524963379    4.176631927490234
CI on main since #5757  7.889825820922852    4.189799785614014   <- loss check fails
after (golden)          7.889825820922852    4.189799785614014
```

### Must fix
1. PR description: the "Summary (human-written)" section is empty. Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`, the author fills it in (one line is enough here, e.g. "Regenerate real-PG SFT goldens missed by #5757").

<details><summary>Details</summary>

- Headers (`config: llama3_debugmodel_sft`, `ngpu: 2`, `FSDP=2`) are unchanged and still match the `IntegrationTestDefinition` at `tests/integration_tests/features.py:1191-1199`.
- Step-1 loss and grad_norm match the failing values quoted in the description for both A10G and MI350X. As with the old goldens, A10G and MI350X agree to about 1e-3, which fits a data-only change on both backends rather than a backend-specific drift.
- #5757 (`899480301`) changed `renderer.py`/`tokenizer.py` and regenerated only the fake-PG golden, so these files were stale from that commit on.

</details>

Not verified: steps 2-10 were taken from the CI artifacts the description cites. I could not re-extract them here. The pending `ciflow/real-pg` and `ciflow/rocm` runs on this PR will confirm them.
